author: Dominik
title: Everything perfect!
content: Great and fast communication, beautiful property.

author: Fernando
content: Julio was very kind with my family when we arrived there, it is a fantastic place to stay with family!

author: Michael
title: Fantastic villa
content: Fantastic villa, as described , wonderful views. Smooth check in and out. 10/10 would visit again.

author: Stefan
content: Great Villa

author: Jam
title: Great overall stay
content: Great overall stay, everyone felt safe secured, and the best part is that everyone had a good stay. Thank you

author: Nadia
title: Amazing views
content: We loved it, had an amazing long weekend with 5 happy kids. Loved the warm pool and amazing views!

author: Svitlana
title: Amazing villa with heated pool!
content:
We had a fantastic stay with my family and some friends. The villa is very modern and luxurious. It was great diving in the heated pool while admiring the great views of the coast.

We found the property very clean and well maintained. Our host Julio was very reactive since the moment I confirmed the booking and gave us very good tips about places to go in the area.

The house is well located in a very secure area, while just a few minutes away from the beach, restaurants in Cancelada and the golf club of Villapadierna.

We will definitely come back!

author: Khalid
title: Great experience, super host
content: Suitable property for large group guests

author: Farrah
title: Amazing villa
content: The house was amazing and so was Julio! However the house had a few problems throughout our week of staying there. Our Air conditioner went out quite a few times. Julio came to help us fix the issue but it was quite frustrating. The pool was supposed to be infinity however it wasn’t full to the top because we were told it had issues as well. Shower in master bedroom didn’t get hot. Lastly there were lots and lots of ants. We expected some because it was summer time however there were a few 100 of them everywhere from the kitchen to the bedrooms which also was quite frustrating. Although we had these issues julio did try to make all the problems better for us. He was a great host and tried his best to fix the problems in a timely manner. House however just needs an overall fix.

author: Erik A.
title: Excellent service and nice people
content:
We hired Marbella in Style to make our holiday more convience. Excellent service and really nice people joing us during our holiday.

They took care of all form early morning to late night – nothing was missing and we could enjoy our holiday.

Perfect choice for a perfect holiday.

author: Erwan
title: Amazing modern house
content:
Amazing modern house, very well equipped.

The pool and the sea view are really great!

Julio was really helpful and give us lot of good recommendations.

Highly recommended!

author: Roy J.
title: Top Villa Marbella in Style
content: An absolutely fantastic week to celebrate my son in laws 40th birthday, with both families, perfect location/stunning Villa. And to top it all had our in house chef who was brilliant, food fantastic, everything he did was perfection. What a week, let’s do it every year

author: Avril W.
title: Villa Service on another level
content: We were lucky enough to spend a long weekend with our best friends in a fabulous villa in Benahavis. Our butler couldn’t do enough for us … breakfast every morning with everything you could ever want and drinks flowing morning noon and night. He absolutely made our trip and I would definitely recommend his services to anyone.

author: Juanjo D.
title: Excellent, short but intense, weekend in Marbella.
content:
We spent a weekend in a beautiful and large villa in Benahavis, in true “James Bond” style.

Oscar, in addition to services expected of a concierge, perfectly covered role of Chef.

Oscar is a great professional, who knows how to be, and plays his role with an exquisite balance between service, elegance and discretion.

We will definitely trust Oscar again on our next stay in Marbella!

author: Jesús
title: Amazing Holiday
content: We were very comfortable in the villa and our butler helped with everything. Thank you very much Oscar!

author: Zach
title: Oscar is the man!
content: Had a fantastic stay at villa Feliz! Oscar really did provide the best service possible to me and my amigos during our stay!

author: Yassine
content:
Wij hebben enorm genoten van ons verblijf. Het is een toplocatie, heerlijk rustig met een prachtig uitzicht, terwijl alles toch dichtbij en goed bereikbaar is. De accommodatie was ideaal gelegen om de omgeving te ontdekken en tegelijkertijd lekker tot rust te komen.

Ook het contact met de contactpersoon verliep heel prettig. We werden vriendelijk geholpen, kregen snel reactie op vragen en voelden ons echt welkom. Al met al een zeer fijne ervaring en zeker een aanrader voor iedereen die op zoek is naar een ontspannen verblijf op een mooie locatie.

author: Kevin
title: A thoroughly successful stay
content: Our stay was a thorough success. The accommodation matched the description and photos exactly — clean, well kept and equipped with everything we needed. Communication with the host was straightforward and friendly, and check-in and check-out went smoothly. The location was ideal for what we needed and we felt at home from the first minute. Happy to return, and a clear recommendation!

author: Mohammed S.
title: Amazing Villa
content:
We had a truly unforgettable experience during our stay at this beautiful villa in Marbella. The property itself was stunning—spacious, well-maintained, and perfectly equipped for a relaxing getaway.

What really made the stay exceptional was the level of service and support we received. The villa manager was always available, incredibly responsive, and went above and beyond to ensure everything ran smoothly from start to finish. Whether it was a quick question or a special request, they were there for us every step of the way.

Highly recommend this villa to anyone looking for a luxurious and worry-free holiday in Marbella. We’ll definitely be coming back!

author: Alex
title: Amazing villa
content: The service was perfect, the villa is absolutely stunning and located in a very nice location.

author: Jaime G.
title: Fantastic House for Family and friends - Golf Luxury
content: Top modern house with all facilities and VIP services. Located in perfect place to relax, play Golf (3 Top courses – one walking the other 2

author: Luis
title: Repetiremos
content: Repetiremos sin duda, increíble los días que hemos pasado

author: Majd
title: Super Villa
content: Super Villa plus belle en vrai que en photo

author: Roland
title: Great villa
content: Great villa…modern, spacious, well equipped, very comfortable and great outdoor space…amazing views on the sea with an ability to see both sunrise and sunset….villa is located in a gated community and close to the Anatara hotel…Marbella and Puerto Banus are within a short 10/15min drive…Julio is very responsive and sorts out any requests…overall a great experience

author: Jonathan H.
title: Brilliant place and facilities
content: What excellent place to stay and really enjoyed it as a family. Can’t wait to book again

author: Nat
title: Great stay at great villa!
content: We had a great stay at this villa! Everything from communication, to check out went super smooth and easy. The service was absolutely top and we couldn’t have asked for more. Feel so blessed that Julio could host us on a very short notice. I send my warmest recommendations! Thank you

author: Amine
title: A high-quality stay
content: A high-quality stay — thank you for taking such good care of us. We will come back without hesitation!

author: Josh
content: Brilliant place, great location & great management

author: Jane Yasemin K.
title: Wonderful Stay
content: We spent five days at Villa Michaela and had a truly wonderful experience. Julio and Oscar went above and beyond to ensure everything was perfectly arranged. Any issues we encountered were resolved quickly and efficiently. Overall, it was a perfect stay, and we’re already planning to book again for next year. If you’re looking for a villa with excellent security and a reliable alarm system, this place is very well set up.

author: Eimer
title: Absolutey 10/10 property
content: The quality of everything right down the the sinks/ towel holders. Everything has been carefully considered & no expense spared. This is our first stay and not our last. We had an amazing breakfast set out every morning by Oscar and had a chef come in the first evening the food was lovely. The aircon in individual rooms made the heat so confortable and literally could have went down to ice cold 😍 My one and only downside was one of the rooms had 2 singles put together to make up a double- but there was a child in that room so it didn’t really matter to us- had I have had that room I would have felt a little annoyed. The pillows where uncomfortable if you like to travel with your pillow I would suggest it. We rented out a car which I would do again for getting groceries. There is a fantastic canopy outside and a cozy outdoor sofa to shade you from the hot sun & the pool was immaculate. The ovens, fridges & appliances were so clean.

author: Holy
content: Absolutely amazing!

author: Laura
content:
Sehr schön gepflegtes und gut ausgestattetes Haus mit Garten und Pool. Die Einrichtung ist ein Traum- eine kleine Wohlfühloase . Tolle Location um Golf zu spielen.

Der Check in und Check out lief reibungslos.

Julio war ein wunderbarer Gastgeber.

Wir hatten viel Spaß und werden bestimmt wieder kommen

author: Marcos
title: Spectacular villa
content: There were no blinds in the rooms doesn’t allow you darkness to sleep.

author: Max
title: Amazing villa for family holidays in Marbella
content: Was amazing

author: William
title: Oscar fantastico
content: Unbelievable service. Oscar was the perfect host that looked after us all from the start to end of our trip. Top guy and great service.

author: Valentin
content:
Magnifique villa avec vue et avec très belle piscine.

Spacieuse et propre.

author: Austin
title: Great Villa
content: and perfect choice for our friends from US. Short break and everyone really liked it. Perfect hosts and all good.

author: Lisa
title: Loved the villa and the scenery
content: It was a bit far out, but for a 3 night stay it was perfect. My sister has a wonderful time. Thanks so much for accomodating us. I would highly recommend!

author: Fallyn
title: Tranquil and cozy home
content: The home has everything you need to settle into for either a long or short stay with a family or friends. It is in a peaceful setting with stunning views of La Concha and even a distant view of the ocean where you get a peak of Africa. The home is clean and the community is private. The parking spot is in a garage which is directly attached to the unit, very convenient. The town of Istan is about 15 minutes up the mountain and beach parking or shopping/eating is about 15 minutes down the mountain. If you are looking for a cozy, private, peaceful, location that is a short drive from it all with stunning views, this is the place for you.

author: Shani
title: Very pleasant experience
content: As a family who like to have the home from home feel this villa provides exactly that, it was very modern and clean and is situated in a great location very close to Puerto Banus (10 mins by taxi) and Old Town Marbella (20 mins). The only thing I’d advise would be to make it aware in the listing that the 5th bedroom is actually outside of the villa and I wouldn’t recommend for families with toddlers.

author: Vishab
title: Excelente propiedad
content: Todo muy bien preparado, limpio y como se ve en las fotografías. Fueron unos días muy plácidos para reuniones y pasar un buen tiempo con familiares y amigos. Gracias.

author: Fahad
title: Our stay at Casa Masari was fantastic
content:
Our stay at Casa Masari was fantastic.

Perfect for our family with two kids, very comfortable, and set in a quiet, peaceful area with a genuinely good location that made it easy to enjoy our time and relax throughout the trip.

author: Eloise
title: Great stay
content: The villa was beautiful, everything was clean and well maintained and the views were amazing. Hosts were responsive and helpful. Would highly recommend !

author: Harriet
content: Really nice property in a beautiful location. The property was spotless and had high quality furniture and finishes. Great pool area and lovely outside areas too.

author: Deji
content: This place was absolutely beautiful and the views are better than the pictures. The accommodation was very clean and well-appointed for a family. The host was responsive. I would highly recommend and seek to be back here when I’m back in town.

author: Alex
title: Excellent accommodation for a family
content: Everything is new, a full kitchen with all the utensils and equipment, a beautiful living room, chic furnished loggias. Excellent garage. Super location, south-facing, beautiful view. Everything is SUPER!!!

author: Fallyn
title: stunning views
content: This condo has stunning views of La concha mountain as well as a glimpse of the ocean and a peak of Africa! The entire community is private and very tranquil. The home has everything you need to be comfortable relaxing, cooking, working and enjoying each other’s company. It is 15 -20 minutes from both the town of Istan (up the mountain) and the ocean (down the mountain). There are serene trails nearby and patio furniture on every deck, including the rooftop. We loved this stay so much! Marbella has so many opportunities for exploring both within and outside of the city. It has great weather, great food, great shopping, great nightlife, great outdoor activities and so much history within a short drive from the home.

author: James
title: amazing time
content: We had an amazing time staying in this property, it’s stunning. Very modern and homely, we will definitely be booking again! Thank you to our host, who was very helpful and always reply’s within 10 minutes!!

author: Christian
title: Everything was fine
content: Everything was fine overall. 👍

author: Natisha
title: The perfect location
content: The perfect location. Very close to Puerto Banus and shops, it’s a little walk but still close enough to access. The pictures fully match the home and loved the decor, however the rooms are small. The host was extremely professional and enjoyable to work with. He was very responsive to any inquiries and to any issues raised. Parking garage is available but not needed as there was ample parking in the complex. The restaurant on the grounds is amazing with delicious food, staff members really nice. I would definitely recommend booking with them. I am so very happy with the accommodations and will definitely book with this location again.

author: Brid
title: wonderful stay
content:
We had a wonderful stay at Casa Dama. The apartment was modern, clean, and secure, and the grounds offered two large swimming pools with a lifeguard and plenty of sunbeds. The on-site Cortes Garden restaurant was excellent for breakfast and lunch, with very friendly staff. Puerto Banús is just an 8–10-minute walk away, or front security can arrange a taxi to the town or nearby beaches.

The team at Marbella In Style was brilliant—quick to respond to any questions about the apartment and happy to share excellent recommendations for local beaches and restaurants.

Thank you for a wonderful stay—we would definitely recommend it.

author: Anna
title: We had a great stay
content: The owner was very helpful and responsive. Totally recommend.

author: Charlie
title: Good experience
content: Place is as described and shown in the pictures and the comms with the host were very easy. Would recommend and attend again myself

author: Denis
title: Amazing place!
content: Amazing place!

author: Lasse
title: We recommend this apartment
content: We recommend this apartment to others and would gladly come back! 😊

author: David
title: fantastic location
content: The place is in a fantastic location and feels very spacious. It was nice and clean, and my family and I felt right at home. We had all the amenities we needed, a well-equipped kitchen, and a roomy living area. We will definitely repeat our experience at this apartment. Thank you for everything!.

author: Neil
title: This host was nothing short of amazing!
content: We went to this apartment after having to leave a horrendous apartment elsewhere after 1 night. We checked in and were kindly greeted by Oscar who helped us in, showed us everything and was always on hand via text. The apartment is enormous with 3 bedrooms and en-suites and a large living area. Apartment was beautiful and had high end appliances throughout. Lots of clean towels and amenities provided, air con in every room and a huge balcony with a beautiful view. Genuinely cannot wait to return, thank you for making our trip to Marbella a dream 😃

author: Fatou
title: Beautiful apartment, everything was as described.
content:
We checked in early on a Sunday and Oscar came to meet us and was extremely nice.

We had a wonderful stay and only had an issue with the hot water (limited tank) which was inconvenient but if they address that issue then everything will be perfect and you will not regret your stay.

author: Alejandro
title: Excellent place with views
content: Excellent place with views, location and cleanliness. I totally recommend staying here.

author: Yusuf
title: amazing apartment
content: Thanks for your amazing apartment

author: Daali H.
title: A lovely place to rest
content: Very beautiful apartments, just like in the photos, with a pleasant sea view and very calm — really a place to rest. Highly recommended 🙏

author: Lilia
content: Très bel appartement, très belle vue, tout était parfait

author: Chadi
title: Hacienda del Señorio de Cifuentes
content: In general best view and hostage has done his best very clean apartment

author: Larisa
title: Exactly as shown in the pictures
content: It was very nice and exactly as shown in the pictures. You can tell that everything is brand new. A few small things are still missing, but overall it was a great stay, and I would come back anytime.

author: Léonard
title: They found a solution quickly
content: There was a small problem on arrival — we had no water — so we had to change villas, but the new villa was even better and they found a solution quickly.

author: Amit
title: Great place to spend your vacation
content: Great place to spend your vacation

author: Johannes
title: Truly outstanding service
content: We arrived spontaneously at 10:00 pm and still managed to check in and move into the property. The service was truly outstanding, and we thank the hosts for making it possible. We would gladly come back. The house is breathtaking, and the views and sense of space are a true symbol of luxury.

author: Thomas
title: Great property amazing in every way
content: Great property amazing in every way

author: Carla
title: A fantastic stay
content: A fantastic stay. The villa is magnificent, even better in real life than in the photos. The outdoor area is beautiful and lovely for sharing time as a group, and the kitchen is perfect for those of us who enjoy cooking. What’s more, the team was very kind and replied to every message instantly. Without a doubt, a place we totally recommend.

author: Krzysztof Z.
title: Wonderful holiday
content: Everything as described. Wonderful holiday.

author: Kathrin
title: A wonderful stay all round
content: We had a wonderful stay all round! The apartment is exactly like the photos – very clean, spacious and tastefully furnished. The amenities are well thought out, and the kitchen has everything you need. The quick and easy communication with the host team deserves special mention – truly exemplary. The location is ideal, especially with a rental car: supermarkets and restaurants are within easy reach. A highlight is the covered balcony with a beautiful view all the way to the sea – perfect for relaxing evenings. Very comfortable beds, blackout curtains and a well-kept, quiet complex make for a high level of comfort. We would come back anytime!

author: Sami
title: Everything was good
content: Everything was good and worked well.

author: Vasyl
title: Beautiful views of Gibraltar
content: Nice apartment with beautiful views of Gibraltar, sea and golf fields with nice 5 stars hotel!

author: Robert
title: A great winter stay
content: A great winter stay. Very quiet community. The continued building of new resorts in the area did have an impact on road access from the A7 from time to time.

author: Nikita
title: Perfect location for a stay with friends
content: Perfect location for stay with a few friends. Stunning sunset views from the balcony. Comfortable beds. The table is a good size for poker with 5 players. The host was very helpful.

author: Martin
title: Great accommodation in a lovely complex
content: Great accommodation in a very beautiful, new and clean complex. The hosts were always reachable and very helpful with everything. We would love to come back and would use Marbella in Style’s service again. Thank you very much for a wonderful time.

author: Melvin
title: I recommend it 100%
content: We had no problems at all with the accommodation; it was clean, well equipped and functional. And as described, the complex is great and well maintained. Great communication with Julio, the host, who helped us several times. I recommend it 100%!
